title: SM-AUTH-005: renew owner sessions on foreground and explicit expiry
authority: Current owner instruction 2026-10-02: تمام كمل بدون توقف و لك جميع الصلاحيات من عندي; continued project development and reviewed merges authorized.
scope: One owner-app session-expiry outcome including serialized credential operations and actionable failure UI.
out_of_scope: Backend token families/schema/RBAC, web sessions, audit coverage, POS transactions, device/production qualification and Telegram.
task: Probe stored access at startup/resume; renew only on explicit 401, serialize credential operations, revoke rotation successors at logout, suppress stale account responses and surface recoverable service errors.
validation: Owner MockClient/secure-storage regressions for concurrent expiry, resume, malformed/rejected refresh, logout race, stale organization and request timeout; widget lifecycle/retry/account-context tests; exact Foundation/Governance CI and full source/diff review.
stop_conditions: Wrong main/task head, unexpected scope overlap, failed required checks, secret exposure or unsupported capability.
success_criteria: Normal expiry recovers once without concurrent rotation; outage preserves stored credentials; logout uses the current queued successor and cannot revive old UI; lifecycle expiry is handled; required CI passes.
